description: Michael A. Chiaradio Democratic Nominee in Mississippi’s 3rd Congressional District Short Bio Michael A. Chiaradio is a farmer and entrepreneur who raises sheep, pigs, and cows in Shubuta, Mississippi. Before starting his farm, Chiaradio earned an MBA from Felician University. He spent four years supervising teams at a global public company that supported the Affordable Care Act and he played in the inaugural season of what later became the Empire Professional Baseball League. His campaign for the United States House of Representatives in 2026 is focused on intelligent public investment that will drive economic competitiveness in rural economies, reinvigorate American industry, and directly benefit the American people.
title: About Me - Michael A Chiaradio
